title: Account Tenure Addition — Northgate Card Credit Line Review Schedule
content:
| Whole calendar months from the account's opened date to the review date | Tenure line addition |
|---|---|
| 36 months or more | 400 dollars |
| 18 months up to 35 months | 200 dollars |
| fewer than 18 months | nothing |

The tenure line addition in the review of a requested credit line increase on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account follows the whole calendar months from the account's opened date to the review date: 36 months or more add 400 dollars; 18 months up to 35 months add 200 dollars; fewer than 18 months add nothing. The opened date is the date on the card account record.

**Counting whole months.** A month is complete when the review date reaches the same day of the month as the opened date; a review date earlier in the month than the opened day leaves that month incomplete.

Hypothetical boundary cases for an account opened on the 20th of a month:

- review on the 20th, 36 months later: 36 whole months, 400 dollars;
- review on the 19th of that same month: 35 whole months, 200 dollars;
- review on the 20th, 18 months after opening: 18 whole months, 200 dollars;
- review on the 19th of that month: 17 whole months, nothing.
